overview: Late at Great St Helen's you set down Will Kemp's reception of the three casting sheets at the Jackdaw: roaring Ercles' vein until Agnes dropped a jug, reading the leaves again to say 'Thou'st put me in, thou villain', and laughing at the spoken ass's head — reminding yourself to keep the other five tradesmen plain and earnest when writing the rehearsal scene.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Recorded Will Kemp's reception of Bottom's casting sheets and notes for the rehearsal scene.
